what: §7.3a 'keep driving with one loose wheel' (P1-S04b): car 0's front left wheel is loose (health 10 of 80, so it loses 15 % of its friction slip) while car 1's wheels are all intact; both roll at 15 m/s on the main straight, 4 m either side of the centreline, with the same inputs: a little throttle, full left lock from 1 s to 2 s, then straight. The loose-wheel car keeps its speed, stays upright on all four wheels, and still steers with authority (within a few degrees of the intact car's heading change). Baselines: no input doesn't turn; mashing doesn't end where the deliberate drive does.
